statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and unexplained collapse
There is concern for paroxysmal arrhythmias
The patient has a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The patient has other cardiac arrhythmias (I49.9)
A long-term continuous ECG study (CPT 93247) is ordered
The purpose is to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances that may be missed on standard monitoring
The claim was denied with reason code CO-22
The denial is based on coordination of benefits protocols indicating care may be covered by another payer
